patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often centered or left-aligned, utilizing generous negative space, especially in the hero and key messaging areas.
Extreme typographic scale contrast, featuring massive, bold, uppercase display headings for impact, paired with a clean, smaller sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A strict monochromatic palette of black and white is used throughout, creating a high-contrast, stark, and sophisticated visual identity.
The main navigation becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling, while the large hero title scales down and parallaxes out of view.
Project showcases are presented as large, full-width image cards with minimal text overlays, often arranged in a grid or staggered layout.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll, which provides a fluid, eased scroll rather than the browser's default behavior.

The hero section features a large, fixed-position title that dynamically scales down and translates upwards, creating a parallax effect as the user scrolls, eventually moving out of view to reveal the content below.
The primary navigation bar transitions from its initial position within the hero to a fixed, sticky state at the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~8-10x body text) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and labels, creating a dramatic contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; all elements, including images and containers, feature crisp, 0px corner radii.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section is very airy, and content sections use generous vertical spacing between blocks, while text within blocks is dense.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extreme typographic scale, particularly the massive, fixed-position hero title that interacts with scroll, immediately sets it apart. This, combined with the stark black and white palette and smooth scrolling, creates a highly impactful and memorable brand presence that feels more like an art installation than a typical website.
